scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -rf .next-dev && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 next dev -p 3000
scripts.dev:webpack: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -rf .next-dev && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 next dev -p 3000
scripts.dev:clean: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf .next-dev && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 next dev -p 3000
scripts.dev:turbo: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -rf .next-dev && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 next dev --turbo -p 3000
scripts.fresh: rm -rf .next && npm run build && rm -rf .next-dev && WATCHPACK_POLLING=true WATCHPACK_POLLING_INTERVAL=1000 next dev -p 3000
scripts.reboot: rm -rf node_modules .next .next-dev && npm install && next dev -p 3000
